place: Atacama Desert hyperarid core, Cerro Pan de Azucar (6 km) / Oficina Dominador (9 km); Antofagasta Region, Chile
sources: USGS TADP site API (https://tadp.astrogeology.usgs.gov/); USGS PAAD WFS (45 sites); NASA Planetary Analog Explorer (https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/analog-explorer/); data/analogs/known_analogs.json (89 sites); Azua-Bustos et al. 2022 review https://doi.org/10.3389/fspas.2021.810426; ESA WorldCover 10m 2021 v200 window read

place: Aksai Chin plateau near Samzungling (11 km) and a pass (2 km); Hotan Prefecture, Xinjiang (Chinese-administered, claimed by India)
